verdict.rationale: Puzzle explicitly supports managing multiple companies/entities under one login (puzzle-docs-38), but true consolidated financial reporting across those entities appears to depend on a third-party integration (Puzzle + Joiin 'Multi-Entity Reporting', puzzle-docs-10) rather than a native built-in consolidation engine. Missing for 10: native in-product consolidation/elimination workflow, first-party documentation of cross-entity financial statement roll-up, and independent/hands-on verification of the Joiin integration working end-to-end.
